identity_impact: Normalized immutable lineage roots, filters, depth, page size, snapshot high-water marks, and authenticated opaque cursor position determine a traversal; publication content identities remain unchanged.
evidence_level: Workspace returns immutable publication envelopes and lineage only; it creates no Apex evidence truth and no formal execution metrics.
fail_closed_behavior: Reject malformed or unknown roots, invalid direction/filter/depth/page bounds, cyclic traversal, and expired, tampered, or query-mismatched cursors without exposing storage internals.
